Title: Aarav's Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Vikram - 46 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Riya - 11 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Aditi - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "What lovely weather!"

[Aarav slips and falls.]

Pallavi: "This is amazing!"

[Aarav hurts his knee.]

Aarav (surprised): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Aarav helps Mother get up.]

Aarav: "Show me too!"

[Aarav sneezes loudly.]

Aarav: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

[Aarav stands in the kitchen. Pallavi, Vikram and Riya stand near him.]

Aarav: "Mom, look over here."

[Aarav makes tea for everyone.]

Riya: "Let's see."

[Aarav chops onions for the curry.]

Riya (laughing): "That's great!"

[Aarav washes the dishes after dinner.]

Riya (surprised): "I really enjoyed today."
